#Librerie
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(anndataR)
```


# funzione h5ad to Seurat
```{r}
h5ad_to_seurat <- function(file_path) {
  
  # load h5ad
  ad <- read_h5ad(file_path)
  
  # expression matrix (AnnData: cells x genes → Seurat: genes x cells)
  expr <- t(ad$X)
  
  # Seurat object
  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = expr,
    assay = "RNA"
  )
  
  # metto i dati nel layer data (caso default: dati già normalizzati)
  obj <- SetAssayData(
    obj,
    layer = "data",
    new.data = expr
  )
  
  # aggiungo metadata se presenti
  if (!is.null(ad$obs)) {
    obj <- AddMetaData(
      obj,
      metadata = ad$obs[colnames(obj), ]
    )
  }
  
  return(obj)
}
```

obj2$GSE <- "GSE154778"
obj3$GSE <- "GSE155698"

obj <- merge(obj1, y=list(obj2, obj3))
obj <- JoinLayers(obj, force = TRUE)
obj
DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"

obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj)
obj <- ScaleData(obj)
obj <- RunPCA(obj)

obj <- RunHarmony(
  obj,
  group.by.vars="GSE",
  reduction="pca",
  dims.use=1:30
)

obj <- RunUMAP(obj, reduction="harmony", dims=1:30)
DimPlot(obj, reduction="umap", group.by="GSE")
